description: Implementation of the D3D11 IndexBuffer class for managing index buffers in Direct3D 11 within the ANGLE project.

classes.name: rx::IndexBuffer11
classes.description: A class that manages a Direct3D 11 index buffer, including initialization, mapping, unmapping, and format retrieval.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the index buffer with specified size, type, and usage.

methods.name: mapBuffer
methods.description: Maps the index buffer for writing, with specified offset and size.

methods.name: unmapBuffer
methods.description: Unmaps the index buffer after writing.

methods.name: getIndexType
methods.description: Returns the type of indices stored in the buffer.

methods.name: getBufferSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the index buffer.

methods.name: setSize
methods.description: Resizes the index buffer if needed, updating size and type.

methods.name: discard
methods.description: Discards the current contents of the buffer, preparing for new data.

methods.name: getIndexFormat
methods.description: Returns the DXGI format corresponding to the index type.
